column1: # ADR-0111, George 2026-10-02: per-skin corrections, one key of one section
# each. `from` is the value upstream ships, and must still be what the pack
# holds or the build fails. Two kinds: a key that draws metadata where it
# cannot be read (text off the screen, the colour of what is behind it,
# under a frame), and a picture named with a typo of a file that is in the
# skin's own folder. Each row is recorded in the pack's doc folder (fixed.txt).
